name: orgforge-plugin
displayName: OrgForge — stand up an AI-native IT company
description: Stands up and runs an AI-native IT business company on Claude Code: it decides what to build, builds through a forced non-skippable SDLC (requirements→design→implement→test→deploy→operate), ships via CI/CD, operates on a reliability budget, and produces REPRODUCIBLE work — same spec ⇒ same process/gates/contracts, and repos that clone-and-run the same for anyone. The org's organs (phase gate, blast-radius caps, doctrine, ledger, schedule) enforce as PreToolUse hooks that actually block, plus per-department subagents and organ slash-commands. Harness-neutral core; this is the Claude Code projection.
